1. Snap the two corners of the drag to whole pixels.
2. With Shift, make the sides equal. With Alt, use the start point as the center.
3. With a fixed ratio or size, set the width and height from the settings.
4. Fill the rectangle with 255 in a new mask. Pixels outside stay 0.
5. Feather the shape when the feather setting is above 0.
6. Combine it with the current selection by the mode.
